# opendraft

> opendraft is a React + Tailwind CSS v4 design system distributed as a shadcn registry and built to be used by AI assistants. Components install as source files into your project with the shadcn CLI, behavior comes from Radix, and every color, radius and timing comes from a small set of theme tokens.

## How to build with opendraft

You are building a React interface with the opendraft design system. Follow these rules. They matter more than your own taste.

### 1. Set up the project once

opendraft ships through a shadcn registry. Components install as source files into the project. There is no npm package to import.

Requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, and a shadcn `components.json`. Next.js is supported but not required.

1. If the project has no `components.json`, run `npx shadcn@latest init`.
2. Add the registry to `components.json`:

```json
{
  "registries": {
    "@opendraft": "https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

3. Install the theme first. It writes the tokens into the global stylesheet:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/theme
```

4. Install each component you use, by name:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/button @opendraft/card @opendraft/prompt-bar
```

5. Load three fonts and expose them as CSS variables: Geist as `--font-geist`, Geist Mono as `--font-geist-mono`, Newsreader as `--font-newsreader`. In Next.js use `next/font/google`.
6. Wrap the app once so motion respects the user's "reduce motion" setting:

```tsx
import { MotionConfig } from "motion/react"

<MotionConfig reducedMotion="user">{children}</MotionConfig>
```

### 2. Use components before writing your own

- Check the component list below before building any UI. If a component fits, install and use it, even if you'd only use part of it.
- Import from where the CLI installs them: `@/components/ui/*` for core pieces, `@/components/motion/*` for motion pieces, `@/components/agents/*` for AI and data pieces.
- Compose screens from components. Don't copy a component's internals into a page.
- Only write a new component when nothing fits. Build it from the existing parts and follow the rules below.

### 3. Style only with tokens

Never hard-code colors, shadows, radii, easings or spring values. Use these Tailwind classes, which read the theme tokens:

| Purpose | Use |
|---|---|
| Page background / text | `bg-background`, `text-foreground` |
| Cards and panels | `bg-card`, `border` (a hairline) |
| Quiet areas, inputs, wells | `bg-muted`, `bg-surface` |
| Secondary text | `text-muted-foreground` |
| Hover background | `bg-accent` |
| Primary action | `bg-primary text-primary-foreground` (blue) |
| Accent text, links, focus strokes | `text-brand`, `border-brand` |
| Solid black buttons and bands | `bg-ink text-ink-foreground` (inverts in dark mode) |
| Status | `text-success`, `text-warning`, `text-destructive` (tints: `bg-success/10`, etc.) |
| Lines | `border-border`, `border-input` |
| Floating layers only (menus, popovers, dialogs) | `bg-popover shadow-md` |
| Extra blues for charts and textures | `bg-blue-50` … `bg-blue-950` |

Don't use Tailwind's palette colors (`bg-gray-100`, `text-emerald-600`, …) and don't add `dark:` color twins. The tokens already switch between light and dark.

### 4. The look

- **Square corners.** Radius is 0 to 6px: `rounded-md` for controls, `rounded-lg` at most for cards. Use `rounded-full` only for avatars, status dots and spinners.
- **Hairlines over shadows.** Structure comes from 1px borders. Shadows are only for things that float above the page.
- **Blue is the primary color.** Use it for the main action and focus. Keep everything else neutral.
- **Type.** Headings use `font-display` (Newsreader, `font-light`, tight tracking). Interface text uses the default sans (Geist). Labels, counts and metadata use `font-mono`; small uppercase section labels use the `eyebrow` utility.
- **Texture.** Use `bg-dots` or the `PixelField` component for background texture. Don't use gradients or blobs.
- **Dark sections.** Add the `dark` class to any section to render it dark in either theme.

### 5. Motion

- Import timings from `@/lib/motion` (installed with any animated component): `spring.snappy` for presses and toggles, `spring.smooth` for panels and layout, `spring.pop` for arrivals, `ease.out` with `duration.base` for fades.
- For menus, popovers and tooltips use the CSS utilities `animate-pop-in` and `animate-pop-out`. For entrances use `animate-fade-up` and stagger with `animation-delay`.
- Use Motion (`motion/react`) for state changes: layout, enter and exit, springs.
- Animate `transform` and `opacity`, not layout properties, and keep motion short.

### 6. Accessibility

Components use Radix primitives and come with keyboard and screen-reader support. Keep it: give icon-only buttons an `aria-label`, keep visible focus rings (`focus-visible:ring-ring`), and don't remove roles or labels when you customise a component.

### 7. Before you finish

- Every color, radius, shadow and timing comes from a token.
- Every piece of UI that exists in opendraft uses the opendraft component.
- The screen works in both light and dark mode.
- Headings use `font-display`; nothing else does.

## Components

### AI Agents

- [Voice Orb](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/voice-orb.md): Breathing WebGL liquid orb that reacts to a voice level or an audio analyser. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/voice-orb`
- [Message Bubble](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/message-bubble.md): Chat bubble surfaces with variants, a pop-in entrance and a collapsible body. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/message-bubble`
- [Message](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/message.md): Message rows with avatar, header, footer, markers and a typing indicator. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/message`
- [Message Scroller](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/message-scroller.md): Transcript that follows streamed output, with a rail for jumping between turns. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/message-scroller`
- [Prompt Input](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/prompt-input.md): Auto-growing prompt box with a model picker, an action menu and send / stop. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/prompt-input`
- [Streaming Response](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/streaming-response.md): Streamed answer with copy, retry, feedback and a sources footer. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/streaming-response`
- [Citations](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/citations.md): Inline citation markers, favicon stacks and a collapsible source list. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/citations`
- [Agent Activity](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/agent-activity.md): Collapsible run log of steps, web searches and tool calls. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/agent-activity`
- [Agent Loading States](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/loading-states.md): Thinking shimmer, elapsed-time progress and rotating reasoning text. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/loading-states`
- [Todo List](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/todo-list.md): Live task plan with per-item progress and a rolling completed count. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/todo-list`
- [Tool Result](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/tool-result.md): Tool call card for terminal, request and file output with status, copy and retry. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/tool-result`
- [Code Block](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/code-block.md): Streaming code with Shiki highlighting, line highlights and copy. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/code-block`
- [File Diff](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/file-diff.md): Streaming unified diff with added and removed counts. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/file-diff`
- [Approval Card](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/approval-card.md): Human-in-the-loop card: stepped questions, or approve / request changes / reject. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/approval-card`
- [Tool Approval](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/tool-approval.md): Permission prompt for a tool call: parameters, allow once or always, deny. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/tool-approval`
- [Image Generation](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/image-generation.md): Image frame with queued, generating, refining and complete states. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/image-generation`
- [AI Sidebar](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/ai-sidebar.md): Resource tree for agent workspaces: select, expand, drag to move and rename. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/ai-sidebar`
- [Chat App](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/chat-app.md): Chat shell with a conversation sidebar that folds away when space runs out. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/chat-app`
- [Question Card](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/question-card.md): One question at a time in a sliding stack with an odometer step counter and auto-advance on single choice. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/question-card`
- [Chat Panel](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/chat-panel.md): Chat panel with context tabs, a scripted reply sequence that starts on send, and a composer. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/chat-panel`
- [Recommendation Card](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/recommendation-card.md): Recommendation with a confidence meter, an alternatives drawer that swaps the pick, and a confirm action. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/recommendation-card`
- [Context Cards](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/context-cards.md): Retrieved context chunks that stagger in, then reveal their source file chips. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/context-cards`
- [Prompt Bar](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/prompt-bar.md): A composer with @ sources, / commands, a model picker, dictation and attachments, plus a self-running demo. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/prompt-bar`
- [Selection Actions](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/selection-actions.md): A contextual AI bar under selected text that animates its width between modes and streams in a rewrite. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/selection-actions`
- [Pixel Loader](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/pixel-loader.md): A 3×3 pixel-grid loader with a shimmering status label and a live elapsed timer, in four motion variants. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/pixel-loader`
- [Thinking Trace](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/thinking-trace.md): An expandable agent trace that shimmers while working, then settles. Steps, reasoning, search and coding variants. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/thinking-trace`
- [Streaming Answer](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/streaming-answer.md): An answer that streams in word by word with an inline citation, then shows actions, sources and follow-ups. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/streaming-answer`
- [Task Rows](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/task-rows.md): Task rows with progress rings, status pills and expandable details, run through a failed, retry, done sequence. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/task-rows`
- [Tool Chips](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/tool-chips.md): An agent run as compact tool-call rows with inline chips, then file-diff chips that preview their diff on hover. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/tool-chips`
- [Agent Screen](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/agent-screen.md): Live agent-screen card that expands to a full-screen viewer with Teach-a-task recording. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/agent-screen`
- [Code Panel](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/code-panel.md): Light editor panel with a line-numbered Code view and a unified Diff view with word-level highlights. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/code-panel`

### Data & Workflows

- [Filter Table](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/filter-table.md): Task table filtered by status chips; rows collapse in place and status pills are tinted by meaning. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/filter-table`
- [Flowchart](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/flowchart.md): Workflow canvas with draggable Trigger and If/Else cards joined by a live bezier connector. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/flowchart`
- [Insight Cards](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/insight-cards.md): Insights carousel with comparison, anomaly and allocation mini-charts and a blurred page crossfade. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/insight-cards`
- [Fine-tune Card](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/fine-tune-card.md): Compact inspector with scrub-able number fields, a sliding segmented control and a Type menu. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/fine-tune-card`
- [Records Table](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/records-table.md): AI spreadsheet grid with property popovers, row-by-row calculation, resizable sticky columns and sorting. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/records-table`
- [Diff Table](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/diff-table.md): A proposed table edit that plays once; click each changed row to keep or drop it before applying. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/diff-table`

### Components

- [Accordion](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/accordion.md): Stacked sections that expand with a spring-driven height animation. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/accordion`
- [Sidebar](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/animated-sidebar.md): Docked, icon rail or off-canvas sidebar with a mobile sheet, menus and sub-menus. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/animated-sidebar`
- [Avatar](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/avatar.md): Image or initials, alone or overlapped in a group. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/avatar`
- [Badge](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/badge.md): Small square status label, with an optional dot. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/badge`
- [Button](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/button.md): Primary, ink, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive and link, with a loading state. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/button`
- [Card](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/card.md): Bordered surface with header, action, content and footer slots. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/card`
- [Checkbox](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/checkbox.md): Checkbox with a drawn check and an indeterminate state. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/checkbox`
- [Command Palette](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/command-palette.md): ⌘K palette with fuzzy search, groups, hints and keyboard navigation. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/command-palette`
- [Data Table](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/table.md): Virtualized table: sort, resize and reorder columns, select rows, edit cells. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/table`
- [Date Range Picker](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/date-range-picker.md): Range calendar in a popover, with month and year choosers and min / max. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/date-range-picker`
- [Dialog](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/dialog.md): Modal dialog that springs in, with header, body and footer slots. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/dialog`
- [Drawer](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/drawer.md): Side sheet with a backdrop that closes on Esc or an outside click. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/drawer`
- [Dropdown Menu](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/dropdown-menu.md): Menu with shortcuts, checkbox items and sub-menus. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/dropdown-menu`
- [Input](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/input.md): Text field with focus, invalid and disabled states. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/input`
- [Kbd](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/kbd.md): Keyboard keys and shortcuts. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/kbd`
- [Label](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/label.md): Accessible label for form controls. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/label`
- [Popover](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/popover.md): Floating panel anchored to a trigger. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/popover`
- [Radio Group](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/radio-group.md): Single choice from a set, with a spring-in indicator. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/radio-group`
- [Select](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/select.md): Dropdown select with groups and labels. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/select`
- [Separator](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/separator.md): Horizontal or vertical hairline. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/separator`
- [Skeleton](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/skeleton.md): Shimmering placeholder while content loads. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/skeleton`
- [Switch](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/switch.md): On / off toggle with a spring-driven thumb. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/switch`
- [Tabs](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/tabs.md): Tabs with a sliding indicator, in pill or underline style. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/tabs`
- [Textarea](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/textarea.md): Multi-line text field that grows with its content. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/textarea`
- [Toast](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/sonner.md): Stacked notifications with actions, themed to the tokens. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/sonner`
- [Tooltip](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/tooltip.md): Short hint on hover or focus, with optional shortcuts. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/tooltip`
- [Search List](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/search-list.md): Command-style search with live filtering, a clear action, a gliding hover highlight and an empty state. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/search-list`
- [Sidebar Nav](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/sidebar-nav.md): Workspace switcher, primary nav and searchable chats that collapse to an aligned icon rail. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/sidebar-nav`

### Motion

- [Action Swap](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/action-swap.md): Buttons whose label and icon roll, blur or cascade between states. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/action-swap`
- [Animated Number](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/animated-number.md): Spring-animated number with Intl formatting. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/animated-number`
- [Blur Text](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/blur-text.md): Text that arrives word by word or character by character. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/blur-text`
- [Copy Button](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/copy-button.md): Copies a value and morphs its icon into a check. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/copy-button`
- [Loader](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/loader.md): Fifteen loading animations, from spinners to ASCII and metaballs. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/loader`
- [Magnetic](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/magnetic.md): Pulls its child gently toward the cursor. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/magnetic`
- [Marquee](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/marquee.md): Seamless scrolling row with faded edges. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/marquee`
- [Pixel Field](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/pixel-field.md): Canvas pixel textures in the blue scale: mosaic, dot matrix and equalizer. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/pixel-field`
- [Preview Rail](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/preview-rail.md): Tick rail with hover previews for jumping between sections. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/preview-rail`
- [Reveal](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/reveal.md): Fades and lifts content into view as it scrolls in. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/reveal`
- [Shimmer Text](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/shimmer-text.md): A light sweep across text, for thinking and loading labels. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/shimmer-text`
- [Spotlight Card](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/spotlight-card.md): Card whose border and surface light up under the cursor. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/spotlight-card`
- [Text Scramble](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms/text-scramble.md): Characters scramble, then resolve to the new text. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @opendraft/text-scramble`

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/docs/introduction): What opendraft is and how it's put together.
- [Use with AI](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/docs/ai): Give an AI assistant one link so it builds with opendraft's components and tokens.
- [Installation](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/docs/installation): Add the registry to a project and install components.
- [Theming](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/docs/theming): Color, type, shape and texture tokens, in both themes.
- [Motion](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/docs/motion): The shared springs, easings and durations in lib/motion.ts.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): these rules plus every component page (props, types, examples) in one file
- [Registry index](https://opendraft-ui.vercel.app/r/registry.json): every installable registry item as JSON
